results.title: ANALYSIS-IMF/World Bank meetings leave developing countries with more questions than answers
results.description: Last weeks meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank yielded no new answers for the developing world to the questions posed by a spreading Middle East war continuing war in Ukraine rising debt payments and a potential AI bubble

results.title: KTR extends medical support to 13-year-old boy with brain cancer
results.description: K.T. Rama Rao pledges support as 13-year-old Vinay seeks advanced brain cancer treatment at Sindhu Hospital.

results.title: Michigan Benches Bryce Underwood at Halftime and Beats Penn State
results.description: Michigan had 80 yards and no points at halftime when Kyle Whittingham replaced Bryce Underwood with freshman Tommy Carr. The Wolverines scored all 21 of their points after the break to beat Penn State 21-18, and Whittingham would not say who starts against Indiana.

results.title: Poland Investigates Suspected Violation of Its Airspace
results.description: Poland is investigating a possible violation of its airspace overnight, the Operational Command of the Armed Forces said.
